title: NEWS2 (National Early Warning Score)
sources: Royal College of Physicians. National Early Warning Score (NEWS) 2, 2017

changelog.change: Initial entry — from ED_ICU_OR_Calculators.xlsx. SpO2 Scale 1 (default) implemented; Scale 2 (target 88–92%, e.g. hypercapnic COPD) noted.
Fixed temperature band — 35.1–36.0 °C scores 1 point (was incorrectly grouped with ≥ 39.1 at 2).

purpose: A single aggregate physiology score to detect and trigger a response to clinical deterioration on the ward or in the ED. A score of ≥ 5 warrants an urgent review; ≥ 7, or 3 in any single parameter, triggers an emergency response.

options.label: New confusion, or responds to Voice / Pain / Unresponsive

interpretation.label: Low — routine monitoring (min 12-hourly); a single parameter scoring 3 → escalate to a nurse-in-charge and increase to min 4–6-hourly obs
Medium — urgent review by a clinician competent to assess the acutely ill; min hourly obs; consider higher level of care
High — emergency assessment by a critical-care-capable team; continuous monitoring; transfer to a higher level of care

notes: SpO₂ Scale 2 is used only for patients with an agreed target range of 88–92% (e.g. hypercapnic chronic respiratory failure) — its scoring bands differ and it should be prescribed by a senior clinician. Any single parameter scoring 3 is itself a trigger regardless of the total.
buildNote: Scale 1 implemented. A Scale-2 toggle and an ACVPU sub-key are future refinements. Score range 0–20.
